story: Charlotte led by 18 in the second half. Grimes' 10th three forced overtime and the Lakers won 118–114, their ninth straight.
aria: Animated Short: Quentin Grimes' 3-pointer from Luka Dončić with 1.7 seconds left in regulation that tied the Hornets 111–111, his 10th three of the night. Lakers win 118–114 in overtime. An original illustration, not traced from footage, not to scale.
